passes: Revati is one of the nakathas for first letters.
Friday is a good day to begin learning.
The thithi, Bright 7 (Saptami), is not one to avoid.
The karana, Vanija, is not Vishti.
Counted from the child's birth star, the day's star gives Mitra, a good tara.
Meena lagna is a dual sign, and no planet is in the 8th house from it.
Outside Rahu kalaya (10:50 to 12:18).
suggestions.age: The child will be 3 years and 8 months old.
